title: Convergence of Boolean block expectations
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $0\le\rho\le1$, and let $F$ be a continuous complex-valued function on the torus $(\mathbb R/\mathbb Z)^{(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})\sqcup(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})}$. For a Boolean vector $x\in\{0,1\}^{nm}$, form $X_m(x)_i=m^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^m\sigma(x_{i,j})$, where $\sigma(0)=1$ and $\sigma(1)=-1$; define $T(X_m(x))_{i,0}=X_m(x)_i\pmod{\mathbb Z}$ and $T(X_m(x))_{i,1}=\sqrt2X_m(x)_i\pmod{\mathbb Z}$, and use the corresponding map on pairs coordinatewise. The uniform average over $x,y\in\{0,1\}^{nm}$, weighted by $2^{-nm}\prod_{i,j}(1+\rho\sigma(x_{i,j})\sigma(y_{i,j}))/2$, of $F(T(X_m(x)),T(X_m(y)))$ converges as $m\to\infty$ to the integral of $F(T(g),T(h))$ under the law of $(G,\rho G+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}H)$, where $G,H$ are independent standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb R^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a continuous complex-valued function on the specified torus
